decisionsTitle: «Cât costă» says each service's cost per month and per year, and Vercel's plan is a setting
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-01**, with two screenshots of «Setări» → «Costuri»: «la costuri vreau să văd defalcat pe lună și per serviciu!» and «aici nu e clar ca e per an...». The first screenshot was the header of «Cât costă»: «Astăzi clubul plătește 306.29 USD + TVA pe an.», with «Din care baza de date e o estimare la ritmul lunii (× 12), nu o factură.» under it. The second was the Mailgun row's «Cost azi»: a bare «180 USD + TVA».

**Why a bare yearly figure misleads.** The club's treasurer pays monthly invoices — Mailgun's month, Neon's month, and since 2026-09-30 Vercel Pro's — and one yearly invoice, the domain's. A yearly figure with no period beside it reads as a price, and «180 USD + TVA» is no invoice anybody will ever receive: it was Mailgun's 15 a month multiplied by twelve inside `platform-plans.ts` and printed with nothing to say so. The yearly sentence summed that, a year of Neon's estimate and the domain's fee into one number with the word «pe an» at its end, which the owner did not see.

**Decision.**
- **The money model keeps the vendor's own period.** A paid cost (`PlanCost`, renamed from `AnnualCost` so nothing is called annual that is not) carries the figure its invoice carries and `billed: "monthly" | "yearly"`: the domain's 10.97 a year, Mailgun's plan price a month (no longer × 12), Vercel Pro's 20 × seats a month. Two pure helpers derive the other figure — `perMonth` (a monthly invoice as it is, a yearly one's twelfth to the cent, a usage plan's estimate) and `perYear` (a yearly invoice as it is, twelve monthly ones, twelve months of the estimate) — both null for a usage plan nothing measures. `annualCostToday` sums `perYear`; the new `monthlyCostToday` sums `perMonth`, with the same shape and the same rule that unmeasured usage adds nothing and marks the total estimated. The header's currency rule stands: every amount in the vendor's currency, no exchange rate, except §511's one euro total on the month card.
- **«Cât costă» says both periods, per service and in total.** The sentence is «Astăzi clubul plătește {month} pe lună, adică {year} pe an.», with «circa» only when an estimate is in it and «+ TVA» on each amount VAT comes on top of; the estimate's note drops «(× 12)». Under it, a breakdown (`PlanCostTable`, a Server Component): one line per service in the cost table's order, «Serviciu» · «Pe lună» · «Pe an», then a bold «Total». A free service says «gratuit» in both cells, an estimate is prefixed «≈», VAT is said per cell, and a usage plan whose pace is unmeasured says «ritm nemăsurat». It is a CSS grid of three columns, never a table that scrolls sideways at 320 pixels; a «?» says what the two columns are.
- **Each service row's «Cost azi» names both figures and which one the vendor bills**: «20,00 USD/lună + TVA · 240,00 USD pe an» for a monthly invoice, «10,97 USD pe an + TVA · circa 0,91 USD/lună» for the domain, «circa … USD/lună, la consum · circa … USD pe an» for Neon Launch.
- **When nothing new is coming, the page says so.** `nextSpend` returns null once the domain, Mailgun and Vercel are all paid; the alert then says «Nu urmează nicio cheltuială nouă: ce e luat temporar (Mailgun, Vercel Pro) se oprește după cursă.» instead of printing nothing.
- **The verdict names what is paid.** «se plătesc domeniul și baza de date… restul gratuite» is false once Mailgun or Vercel is paid, so a new verdict `paysForPlans` comes whenever any row besides the domain is `paid` (after `notFree` and `freeButAtALimit`, as before; `paysForUsage` stays for the Neon-only case). Its sentence is built from the paying rows, never fixed: «Se plătesc: {services}; restul serviciilor sunt pe planuri gratuite.», each service a short name with its plan (`freeVerdict.paidName.*`), joined with the locale's `Intl.ListFormat`.

**Vercel's plan became a setting now.** The club pays Vercel Pro since 2026-09-30 (the function quota before the 21 November race), and the page printed Hobby, a free Vercel row, and «Prima cheltuială care urmează: Vercel Pro». The plan is `platform_settings.vercelPlan` — Hobby or Pro and the developer seats (1–20) with a note — set by an Administrator on a new card, «Planul Vercel (găzduirea)», right after the database's card and before «Cât costă», and audited as `vercel_plan.changed` (from and to, with the seats, and the note) under its own fixed entity id. Hobby is the default, so a deployment that never set it reads exactly as before. On Pro the Vercel row is paid monthly at 20 × seats with VAT on top (the invoice decides; the treasurer adds it as for Mailgun), nothing is reached and the row is "ok" (the non-commercial clause no longer applies), there is no next plan, the bump is temporary, and its sentences (`services.vercel.pro.*`) say what Pro gives — the seats at $20 a month and $20 of usage credit included, as `docs/PLATFORM.md` quotes them — that its ceiling is not measured here, that usage beyond the credit is billed on top, and that it goes back to Hobby after the race. «Luna aceasta»'s Vercel line on Pro is the seats' price so far and projected, with VAT, last month the same plan's price (as Mailgun's is), and the build minutes counted with no ceiling, because Pro's is not recorded and none is invented.

**Copied from §100 and §326, and what differs.** The shape is the Mailgun plan's (§100) and the Neon plan's (§306/§326): a key–value row with no migration, a strict zod schema whose unreadable value falls back to the default, the service asserting `canManageClubSettings` as the action does, the same confirm words and `RecallField`s, a refusal handed back as the form's state. Two things differ. Pro is priced per seat, so the setting carries the seats and the card says who set it and when. And Vercel's API is not asked: the setting is the plan. The follow-up is §326's shape — Vercel's own answer first, the setting as the fallback.

**Tests.** `diagnostics/platform-plans.test.ts`: `perMonth`/`perYear` both ways (15 a month → 180 a year, 10.97 a year → 0.91 a month, two seats → 480 a year, 9.61 a month of usage → 115.32, unmeasured → null), both totals with the domain, Mailgun Basic, Vercel Pro and Neon Launch all paying, the Vercel row on Hobby and on Pro, `nextSpend` null when everything is paid, the `paysForPlans` verdict and its order, and every key the page reads in both languages. `diagnostics/month-costs.test.ts` and `month-costs-read.test.ts`: the Pro line and the totals with it. `diagnostics/vercel-plan.test.ts` (the schema) and the PGlite `integration/diagnostics/vercel-plan.test.ts` (the default, an Administrator's save, the refusals, the audit row, the cost table following it). `diagnostics/plan-cost-table.test.ts` renders the breakdown. `e2e/tasks-cost.spec.ts` asserts the new sentence, the two column headers, one line per service and the Vercel card.

*Rejected:*
- **A lei conversion.** The file's currency rule: no vendor invoices in lei except the registrar, at a rate nobody knows in advance; §511 keeps its one euro total on the month card, and nothing else converts.
- **Hiding the free rows.** The owner asked per service: a free service is a row that says «gratuit», so the table is complete and its total visibly sums all of it.
- **Reading the plan from Vercel's API in this change.** The endpoint and its answer could not be verified from the phone session; §326's shape — Vercel's answer first, the setting as fallback — is the follow-up.
- **Counting Vercel's $20 usage credit as a cost.** It is included in the seat's price, not billed on top of it; only usage beyond it is, and the page says so in words rather than as a figure it cannot measure.
changelogLine: - **«Cât costă», pe lună și pe an, serviciu cu serviciu** — the money page lists every service with its monthly and yearly cost and the totals, says which one the vendor bills and where VAT comes on top, and knows Vercel's plan from a new setting on «Costuri». §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given «Setări» → «Costuri», when the page renders, then «Cât costă» states the club's cost per month and per year in one sentence, lists every service with a per-month and a per-year amount and a total line — a free service saying so, an estimate marked, VAT named per amount — and each service row's «Cost azi» names both figures and which one the vendor bills; the Vercel plan (Hobby or Pro with its seats) is an Administrator's setting on the same page, audited like the Mailgun plan, and on Pro the row, the month card and the totals carry its monthly price (2026-10-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
